tagline: 玛米亚微型相机，1959 年发布
description: 玛米亚于1959年推出的微型相机。配备Mamiya-Sekor f2.8 25mm lens, stopping down to f16。快门速度Speeds set manually between 1/5 (1/2 on some models) and 1/200, plus 'B'。使用16mm film。Manual guess focus, focusing down to 0.3 meters/1 foot.。

specs.镜头: Mamiya-Sekor f2.8 25mm lens, stopping down to f16
specs.对焦: Manual guess focus, focusing down to 0.3 meters/1 foot.
specs.快门: Speeds set manually between 1/5 (1/2 on some models) and 1/200, plus 'B'
specs.光圈: set manually from f2.8 and f16, by rotating the calculator wheel to match shutter speed to meter needle
specs.取景器: optical bright frame finder with parallax marks
specs.闪光灯: PC socket on camera base plate with accessory shoe to the side of the selenium meter
specs.英文简介: The Mamiya 16 Automatic is a subminiature viewfinder camera taking 10x14mm images on 16mm film.
